attchmntText: Nahar Industrial Enterprises Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Nahar Industrial Enterprises Limited approved its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 during a Board meeting on 14 November 2026. The results were reviewed by statutory auditors M/s KR Aggarwal & Associates. Net profit for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 was Rs 2593.85 lacs, compared to Rs 1875.04 lacs in the corresponding period. For the half year, net profit stood at Rs 5121.75 lacs versus Rs 2273.77 lacs previously. Net sales for the quarter were Rs 34367.06 lacs. The company reported a fire incident at its Lalru unit in May 2026, with the insurance claim expected to be settled by March 2027. Total assets as of 30 September 2026 were Rs 199651.42 lacs.
